response.justification: Bogdan is a solid, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with ~15+ years of experience and an entrepreneurial streak (GISCollective), but his career has remained at Senior/Staff IC levels without evidence of Director-level scope, strategic customer advisory, or cloud/AI platform strategy work. His AI exposure is limited to recent MCP tooling and agentic infrastructure contributions, which falls well short of the 'recognized AI expertise with demonstrated products built with AI' bar this role requires.
strengths: Broad, deep technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure engineering
Entrepreneurial experience running an independent open-source platform (GISCollective) for nearly a decade
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, teaching workshops, community talks
concerns: No evidence of Director/Principal-level scope, strategic influence, or org-wide technical leadership
AI/ML experience is minimal and recent (MCP tooling), not a demonstrated track record of AI product/platform building
No experience advising external strategic customers/partners or shaping cloud product strategy

key_factors.factor: Lack of Director-level strategic leadership experience
Minimal, recent AI/ML expertise relative to role's AI strategy focus
Strong general engineering breadth and entrepreneurial background
